alice_sales: FYI - SummitAI POC asks for a short hosted rate break: gen $0.0004/token, embed $0.00008/token for 3 weeks. They estimate 25M gen tokens/week. Need decision ASAP. cc @marc_deal @hana_fin

marc_deal: Do they want a commitment? And what's current list and min charge?

alice_sales: No commit. List gen $0.0008, embed $0.0002, min $500/mo. They asked to waive min.

hana_fin: Quick calc: 25M *3 *0.0004 = $30k gen, embeds approx $3.6k total. Finance will approve if we add a hard cap and label as one-time promo. Need GL code.

leo_salesops: We can create promo plan "poc-summitai-3w" and cap at 90M tokens. Option A: set per-token override rates and hard cap. Option B: $35k prepaid credit. Which do you want?

alice_sales: Promo + hard cap preferred so metrics live in console.

infra_bot: Infra can enforce cap and attach billing label. Send account id and promo id when ready. No infra changes needed.

hana_fin: Approve in principle pending signed POC addendum and GL 4010-TRIAL. Please record estimated spend in Deal Desk ticket.

marc_deal: I'll draft addendum and request signed copy today. If customer insists on lower rates, offer $35k prepaid instead.

alice_sales: On it, will update thread once signed. :thumbsup:
